title: BetaClaudeTagSlackChannel
description: A Slack channel set up for Claude Tag, with the settings it stores or, with `include_inherited`, the settings that apply in it.

id.description: The channel's identifier. Starts with `slch_`. It does not change for as long as the channel is set up, with one exception: a channel that is not configured can get a new one. A channel that is removed and set up again also has a new one. The old one keeps returning 404; look the channel up by its Slack identifiers for the new one.

slack.description: Slack's own identifiers for the channel.

settings.description: What the channel itself stores or, with `include_inherited`, what applies in it. `sources` says which.

sources.description: For each setting, the settings level its value in `settings` comes from.

created_at.description: Time the channel was set up, by whichever route. It does not change for as long as `id` does not.

updated_at.description: Time Claude Tag's record of the channel last changed. It moves on every change to a setting, and can also move when something no response holds changes, so a later value says to read the channel again, not that a setting changed. Attaching or detaching a Bundle does not by itself move it.
